name: Question 12
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 2 \\ -6 & 7 & 1 \\ -7 & -5 & 2\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 \\ -8 & 6 & 1 \\ -11 & -7 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

By applying elementary column operations of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary column operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the left of ${a}_{13}=2$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 2 \\ -6 & 7 & 1 \\ -7 & -5 & 2\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-2{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 2 \\ -8 & 7 & 1 \\ -11 & -5 & 2\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 2 \\ -8 & 6 & 1 \\ -11 & -7 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-2{C}_{3}\,$ and $\,{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-{C}_{3}.$

Question 12
?

A=[422−671−7−52],B=[002−861−11−72]

By applying elementary column operations of the form Ci:=Ci+kC3, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the elementary column operations?

a
C1:=C1+2C3 and C2:=C2−C3
b
C1:=C1−2C3 and C2:=C2−C3
c
C1:=C1−6C3 and C2:=C2−C3
d
C1:=C1−C3 and C2:=C2−2C3
e
C1:=C1−2C3 and C2:=C2+C3
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To transform A into B, we need to make entries to the left of a13=2 equal to 0.

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

A=[422−671−7−52]C1:=C1−2C3∼[022−871−11−52]C2:=C2−C3∼[002−861−11−72]=B

Therefore, the elementary column operations are

C1:=C1−2C3 and C2:=C2−C3.
